steps.title: Create a sales order
steps.text: This tour shows you how to start transaction VA01 and fill in the first screen.

steps.title: Start the transaction
steps.text: Click the command field, type the transaction code and press Enter.

steps.title: Order type
steps.text: Enter the order type for a standard order.

steps.title: Sales organization
steps.text: Enter your sales organization, for example 1010. Then press Enter to continue to the item screen.
